sloka: उपस्थितै रञ्जलिकारिभिश्च ।सोपायनैर्जानपदैर्जनैश्च ।कोट्या परार्धैश्च विमुक्तयानैः ।समाकुलं द्वारपदम् ददर्श ॥२-१५-४६॥
transliteration: upasthitai rañjalikāribhiśca ।sopāyanairjānapadairjanaiśca ।koṭyā parārdhaiśca vimuktayānaiḥ ।samākulaṁ dvārapadam dadarśa ॥2-15-46॥

translations.english: He saw villagers and others in crores and parardhas, leaving their chariots and thronging the gateway, (some) paying obeisance with folded palms and (some) carrying gifts in their hands.
